covpp.district.district module

District data management module for zone creation and coverage planning orchestration.

class DistrictData(spa: SpaceAnalyzer)

Bases: object

Manage district-level data, zones, and coordinate coverage planning operations.

This class serves as the high-level orchestrator for the coverage planning pipeline at the district level. It creates and manages zones, coordinates coverage planning across all zones, and aggregates results.

Parameters:

spa (SpaceAnalyzer) -- SpaceAnalyzer object containing processed workspace data.

spa_obj

Reference to the SpaceAnalyzer object.

Type:

SpaceAnalyzer

dmd

District map data.

Type:

ZoneMapData

zone_datas

List of ZoneData objects representing subdivisions.

Type:

list[ZoneData]

district_evaluator

Handler for district-level statistics evaluation.

Type:

DistrictEvaluationHandler

district_stats

Aggregated district statistics object.

Type:

DistrictStatsBase

Example

>>> district = DistrictData(space_analyzer)
>>> district.create_zones_hl()
>>> district.run_planning_pipeline()
create_zones_hl() → None

Create all zones in the district and initialize high-level map planning.

This method creates zone subdivisions and updates the district-level planning visualization map.

run_planning_pipeline() → None

Execute coverage planning pipeline for all zones and aggregate statistics.

This method runs the complete planning pipeline (segmentation, path planning, sequencing, evaluation) for each zone, then aggregates district-level performance statistics and updates the final planning visualization.

create_zones() → None

Create zones based on rectangle subdivision method.

Generates zone rectangles, creates ZoneMapData for each zone, and initializes ZoneData objects.

update_map_planning() → None

update district map_planning based on all zones map_planning.

save_map_planning() → None

save district map_planning to file.

create_zone_rectangles_1() → list[Rectangle]

create two zone rectangles by splitting the district rectangle into two halves.

create_one_zone_rectangle() → Rectangle

create one zone rectangle covering the whole district.

Manage zone-level data and execute complete coverage planning pipeline.

This class coordinates all zone-level operations including segmentation, coverage path planning, path sequencing, and performance evaluation.

>>> zone.zone_planning_pipeline()
initialize()

Initialize zone data by saving map data and creating initial planning map.

zone_planning_pipeline()

Execute complete coverage planning pipeline for the zone.

Pipeline Steps:

  1. Segmentation: Divide zone into cells

  2. Coverage Planning: Generate paths for each cell

  3. Sequencing: Optimize cell order and connect paths

  4. Evaluation: Compute performance statistics

  5. Post-processing: Update visualization maps

This method orchestrates all planning operations and measures execution time.

post_planning()

post planning operations: 1. update map_planning with coverage path and sequence. 2. save map_planning. 3. save map showing cleaned area and uncleaned area.

set_zone_complete_path()

set the complete connected path for the zone from sequencing handler.

create_map_planning()

create initial map_planning with zone boundary.

save_map_planning()

save zone map_planning and map_segmentation to files.

save_map_map_cleaned()

save map showing cleaned area and uncleaned area.
